recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current specification reflects the FHIR-17085 decision, and further changes to Bundle duplicate/version semantics should go through a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-17085 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I issue asking to remove document/message duplicate prohibitions, allow multiple versions of a resource in a Bundle, warn about ambiguous unversioned references, document transaction/batch discretion and Provenance use cases, and update Bundle reference resolution for version-specific references.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 13895, which corresponds to git commit 7633fe38902205aa7792b94ed25e0666cf8e5a91. That commit removed the Bundle-type duplicate prohibition table from source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml and added the multiple-version, ambiguity, Provenance, and transaction/batch guidance.
additional_context: Bundle is active current-build source in source/fhir.ini. Later Bundle work preserved and refined the same semantics: FHIR-29803 cleaned up conformance wording in the uniqueness section, FHIR-29271 and FHIR-31422 rewrote the Bundle reference-resolution algorithm, and FHIR-31986 fixed bdl-7 to compare fullUrl plus meta.versionId for resource-bearing entries.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml already contains the multiple-version and ambiguity guidance, current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml has the matching bdl-7 invariant, and the current reference-resolution algorithm handles version-specific references.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue cleaned up conformance wording and a typo in the same Bundle uniqueness section while preserving FHIR-17085 semantics.
Later Published issue rewrote Bundle reference resolution and included version-specific reference handling.
Later Published issue paired with FHIR-29271 to clarify URI schemes and Bundle reference wording.
Later Published issue fixed the bdl-7 invariant for same-fullUrl entries with different meta.versionId values and is already represented on the combined branch.
